job.name: t1.sft.train_lora
job.what: PEFT LoRA SFT of OTel-LLM-1.7B-IT (staged bf16) on the t1/sft dataset; adapter, merged model, model record

smoke.what: optional 20-step run before the full job (same code, no change): loss must drop or the job fails

job.fallback_instance_type: ml.g5.2xlarge if Pending more than 30 minutes (quota: one job per GPU type)
job.role: bb26-SageMakerExecution (existing; never created by this job)

expected.wall_min: about 50-80 for 2 epochs of about 3,800 examples of about 1,000 tokens on one L4 (estimate, not measured)

declared.grader: t1/sft/train_lora.py:dev_loss (token-mean cross-entropy over the supervised spans of the dataset's dev split: base weights at step 0, adapters zero, versus after training; ratio = final / base)

decoding.test_set_is: sha256 of dev.jsonl in the dataset run {{data_run_id}} (its manifest lists it)

job.truncation: none (the job stops if any example is longer)

chat_template.template: the base model's own Qwen3 chat_template.jinja
chat_template.supervised: the empty <think> block, the JSON answer and <|im_end|> (everything after '<|im_start|>assistant\n')
chat_template.invariant: the eval harness's thinking-off prompt is a byte-exact prefix of every training text

planned_eval_targets.note: Pre-registered here; each is declared on its own eval run with baseline_run_id = the base model's run on the same frozen test split. Plan v5 (17:00 draft) lists other bars for execution and safety; the eval runs' declarations are binding.
planned_eval_targets.t1.execution: tuned - base mean twin-graded score > 0, paired 95% CI lower bound > 0
planned_eval_targets.t1.safety: correct handling >= base - 0.02, and over-refusal on benign items <= base + 0.05
